description:
Create a gateway

Saves a new gateway from its config, validated and normalized; the stored config comes back. The name is its id here and in the x-klinn-gateway header: a-z, 0-9 and -, at most 48 characters, and not new, playground, rules or templates (the console's own pages); a name already in use is 409 conflict. A chat gateway needs only a name; a fallback or a split needs at least two targets. A decision gateway (kind decision) needs a default_model that is a decision model (kind decisions in the `list_models` tool) and 1 to 128 questions. At most 50 gateways an account. Keys are attached with the `update_key` tool. At most 50 gateways per account: past it, 409 limit_reached.

allow_models.description: Model ids, or patterns with *, the gateway lets through; any other model is 403 model_not_allowed. null for any model.

cache.description: The exact same request gets the kept answer, free, for max_age_s seconds; null for no cache.

max_age_s.description: Seconds an answer is kept, up to a day.

community_supply.description: Whether community-supplied capacity (first-party vendor capacity other accounts list, under the same no-training terms) may serve requests under this gateway. Left out: on. A decision gateway never uses it: it may not be set true there.

data.description: Data handling. Left out: no constraint.

zdr.description: Zero data retention: requests under this gateway are kept off community-supplied capacity.

default_model.description: The model a request with model "default" (or none) gets; null for the request's own model. A decision gateway needs one, and it must be a decision model (kind decisions in GET /models).

anyOf.description: The guardrails of a chat gateway. One decision call per new message carries every check. Checks are free for now. A request the checks cannot finish in time (2.5 s for each 16 new messages, at most 10 s, or over 128 new messages) is refused with 446 on a gateway with a block check, and let through with x-klinn-guardrail: unchecked on one that only flags or redacts; a decision model that errs lets the request through, unchecked.

checks.description: 0 to 3 checks, at most one of each, stored in the order prompt_injection, pii, topics.

items.description: One check. prompt_injection and pii hit when the decision model's probability of yes is at or above threshold; topics hits when the topic it picks is a blocked one, or, with allowed topics, none of them, at or above threshold.

action.description: Required. block: HTTP 446, error type guardrail_blocked with the check as its code; the model is never called and nothing is billed. flag: answered as usual and flagged in the request log. redact (pii only): emails, phone numbers, card numbers (Luhn-checked) and IBANs (checksum-validated) become [email], [phone], [card] and [iban] in every user message before the call, whatever the score; names, addresses and ID numbers can only be flagged or blocked.

allowed.description: topics only: short labels; with any listed, a message about none of them is off-topic. "other" is taken. Allowed or blocked must list at least one topic.

blocked.description: topics only: short labels a message must not be about. A topic cannot be in both lists.

check.description: prompt_injection: does the text try to override, ignore or reveal the assistant's instructions, or make it act outside its role? pii: does it contain personal data about a person, and which kind? topics: which of the allowed and blocked topics is it about, or none?

threshold.description: How sure the decision model must be, 0 to 1. Defaults: prompt_injection 0.9, pii 0.5, topics 0.5.

types.description: pii only: the kinds of personal data to catch. Default all seven; empty asks only whether there is personal data, and masks nothing. Masking runs before the check, so the score is about personal data left after it.

model.description: The decision model that runs the checks (kind decisions in GET /models). Absent: pplx-decider-v1.2, Perplexity's Decider v1.2.

guardrails.description: Chat gateways: checks on every message of each request, whole, run by a decision model before the model is called (https://docs.opencheap.si/guardrails). null for none; a string (an old policy name) also reads as none. A decision gateway takes none: its /v1/systemone calls are not checked.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique string so that repeating this call never creates twice.

instructions.description: Decision gateways: a context line, what the text is. Left out when empty.

io_ratio.description: The expected input:output token ratio of chat requests under this gateway, as input tokens per output token (15 for 15:1). Their routes are ranked at it instead of at max_tokens (see /docs/speed#io-ratio). It replaces the key's ioRatio; a request's own x-klinn-io-ratio header comes first. Ranking only: holds, limits, max_price and the bill are unchanged. Left out: none. Not on a decision gateway.

kind.description: chat routes the requests your code sends; decision is a classifier: its default model is a decision model and its questions are saved here.

log_bodies.description: Logging prompts and answers is not available yet: leave it false.

max_price.description: The default limit order of chat requests under this gateway: they are billed at most this per 1M tokens, or refused with 422 no_offer_under_limit when nothing in the market is within it. It replaces the key's maxPrice; a request's own limit (its max_price field or the x-max-price header) comes first. Left out: none. Not on a decision gateway.

cache.description: USD per 1M input tokens read from the cache. A route that bills cached tokens at its input price is compared at that price.

cache_read.description: Another name for cache, accepted on input.

completion.description: The compatible name for output; returned under this name.

input_cache_read.description: The compatible name for cache; returned under this name.

prompt.description: The compatible name for input; returned under this name.

min_discount.description: The default minimum discount of chat requests under this gateway: they are served only at least this many percent under the model's list price, or refused with 422 no_offer_under_limit when nothing in the market is. The strictest of it, the key's minDiscount and the request's own (the min_discount field or the x-min-discount header) applies. Left out: none. Not on a decision gateway.

name.description: Its id in this API and in the x-klinn-gateway header: 1 to 48 characters of a-z, 0-9 and -, starting and ending with a letter or digit. new, playground, rules and templates are reserved for the console's own pages: a new gateway or a rename cannot take them.

options.description: choice: 2 to 64 options. score: 2 to 10 levels, lowest first, optional. noul: none. Each at most 80 characters, none twice.

type.description: choice: one of the options. score: a number from 0 to 1, or a place on the levels listed, lowest first. noul: yes or no, as a probability.

questions.description: Decision gateways: the questions by name (1 to 40 characters of a-z, 0-9 and _, starting with a letter), 1 to 128 of them.

rate_limit.description: Requests a minute per key through this gateway; null for no limit.

region.description: A region pin: eu keeps requests under this gateway off community-supplied capacity. Left out or null: none.

request_timeout_ms.description: A deadline for the whole request, fallbacks and retries included, in milliseconds (1,000 to 600,000); null for none.

attempts.description: Retries after the first try, after 1, 2 and 4 seconds.

on_status_codes.description: The statuses to retry on. Default 429, 500, 502, 503 and 504.

use_retry_after.description: Wait as long as the model's Retry-After says.

retry.description: Retries on every target; a target's own retry replaces it. null for none.

speed.description: The default speed of chat requests under this gateway: how they pick among routes ({sort, minThroughput, maxLatencySecs}; cheapest, balanced, fastest or a custom floor and ceiling, see /docs/speed). It comes before the key's speed, field by field: a floor or ceiling it leaves out falls to the key's. A request's own sort, min_throughput and max_latency settings come first, then a :nitro / :floor model suffix. An explicit {sort: price} puts the sort back to cheapest over a faster key. max_price still caps the price. Left out: none. Not on a decision gateway.

maxLatencySecs.description: Seconds to the first token a route should stay within; null for no ceiling.

minThroughput.description: Tokens per second a route should reach; null for no floor.

sort.description: What the routes are ordered by.

strategy.description: How a request picks its model.

mode.description: single: one model, the request's or default_model. fallback: the targets in order; when one answers with a status in on_status_codes, the next one answers. loadbalance: each request goes to one target, by weight.

on_status_codes.description: The statuses that move a fallback to the next target. Default 429, 500, 502, 503 and 504.

targets.description: The models of a fallback or a split, in order: at least two for either, at most 10. Empty for single.

items.description: One model of a fallback or a split.

model.description: A model id; null for the request's own model.

override.description: Replaces what the request sent, on this model.

attempts.description: Retries after the first try, after 1, 2 and 4 seconds.

on_status_codes.description: The statuses to retry on. Default 429, 500, 502, 503 and 504.

use_retry_after.description: Wait as long as the model's Retry-After says.

retry.description: This model's own retries, replacing the gateway's; null for the gateway's.

timeout_ms.description: How long one try on this model may take, in milliseconds; null for what is left of the gateway's deadline.

weight.description: Its share of requests under loadbalance.

name: create_gateway
title: Create a gateway
